recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a woman with long hair, rendered in a high-key, monochromatic orange-yellow palette. The image features thin, wide-spaced sans-serif typography at the top and bottom edges, creating a frame-like effect around the central facial features.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic color harmony between subject and background
Symmetrical typographic framing at top and bottom margins
Tight cropping focusing on eyes, nose, and lips
Soft-focus texture contrasting with sharp typographic lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, filling the entire frame; eyes positioned in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, which provide the only dark contrast in the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical flow from the top text line, down through the facial features, to the bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject's hair acts as the textural background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber-orange (#FFB347) across skin and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burnt orange (#8B4513) for shadows in eyes and lips.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Thin dark outlines for the typography to ensure legibility against the bright background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High brightness with low tonal range, creating a glowing, ethereal effect.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Large tracking (letter spacing) to span the full width of the composition
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and thin profile.
Provides the geometric circularity seen in the 'O' and 'R'.
Modern geometric structure with wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail, extreme close-up portrait of a woman with long straight hair. Apply a monochromatic amber-orange color grade. The lighting should be soft and high-key, washing out fine details while keeping the eyes and lips defined in a darker shade of the same hue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif font. One line at the very top, one at the very bottom. Set text to all-caps with wide tracking so it spans the width of the image. Use a thin dark orange outline for the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic warm tones?
Is the tracking wide enough to span the image width?
Is the crop tight on the facial features?

adjustableVariables: Hue (can shift from orange to gold or sepia)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the hair texture.
Verify the monochromatic filter is consistent across the entire frame.
Check that the eyes are the primary focal point.
Confirm the typography does not obscure the eyes or mouth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic high-key portrait + Hairline geometric sans-serif + Symmetrical top/bottom framing.
